stories.text: As a learner, I want to sign in with the required account fields and verification challenge, so that I can access the platform using my existing account.
As a learner, I want to receive actionable validation and authentication errors, so that I can correct failed sign-in attempts.
As a learner, I want to open an authorized page directly and refresh it, so that I can resume work through bookmarked links.
As a learner, I want to have expired sessions handled explicitly, so that I can reauthenticate without mistaking stale data for current results.
As a learner, I want to distinguish inactive-account, forbidden-resource and signed-out states, so that I understand why an action is unavailable.
As a learner, I want to see the navigation and platform configuration applicable to my account, so that I can find the features available to me.
As a learner, I want to view my homepage recommendations and learning overview, so that I can choose my next activity.
As a learner, I want to view notices, inspect details and mark them read, so that I can keep track of relevant updates.
As a learner, I want to manage my permitted to-do items and favorites, so that I can organize ongoing work.
As a learner, I want to sign out and clear account-specific client state, so that another session does not inherit my information.
As a learner, I want to browse current and historical experiments with supported filters, so that I can find the experiment I need.
As an authorized experiment editor, I want to create an experiment from the permitted scene and configuration, so that I can prepare a training workspace.
As an authorized experiment editor, I want to edit experiment metadata, tags and supported release settings, so that I can keep the experiment configuration accurate.
As an authorized experiment editor, I want to delete only experiments I am allowed to delete with the documented effects, so that I can manage obsolete experiments.
As a learner, I want to open experiment details and its available subpages, so that I can work within one consistent experiment context.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to browse available devices and place nodes on the canvas, so that I can construct a scene.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to move nodes and navigate the canvas through zoom and pan, so that I can arrange and inspect the topology.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to connect valid device ports and configure links, so that I can express the intended network structure.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to inspect and edit supported device and node properties, so that I can configure the scene correctly.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to select multiple objects and use supported grouping, resizing and rotation, so that I can manipulate complex scenes efficiently.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to use supported annotations, drawing elements and topology templates, so that I can document and reuse scene designs.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to use context menus and toolbar actions available for the selected object, so that I can perform the correct operation in context.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to save a topology and reopen its nodes, links, positions and configuration, so that I can trust that my work is persisted.
As an authorized topology editor, I want to retain unsaved edits when saving fails and receive an unsaved-work warning when appropriate, so that I can recover from interruption.
As a read-only experiment viewer, I want to inspect a shared or locked topology without editing actions being incorrectly enabled, so that I can review the scene within my permissions.
As an authorized experiment operator, I want to start, stop, release or extend a permitted environment, so that I can manage my training resources.
As an authorized experiment operator, I want to see asynchronous environment and node states, errors and refresh results, so that I can tell whether an operation actually succeeded.
As an authorized experiment operator, I want to open an authorized device console and reconnect when appropriate, so that I can interact with a running device.
As an authorized experiment operator, I want to use supported capture, traffic simulation and mirroring controls, so that I can inspect network behavior in my permitted scene.
As a learner, I want to inspect capture records and obtain permitted capture files, so that I can review experiment observations.
As a learner, I want to read the experiment overview and scene instructions, so that I understand the training context.
As an authorized note editor, I want to read, edit and save experiment notes, so that I can retain my observations.
As an authorized note editor, I want to upload supported images and export experiment notes to Word, so that I can produce usable experiment documentation.

As an experiment participant, I want to browse the five detection tool categories and read tool information, manuals and related materials, so that I can understand and obtain the available detection resources.

As an authorized experiment participant, I want to follow attack-teaching activities and configure permitted simulated-blue-team resources, so that I can complete the scene-specific training workflow.
As a learner, I want to search and filter public courses and inspect course details and catalogs, so that I can choose suitable learning material.
As a learner, I want to receive accurate course-entry and course-unavailability feedback, so that I do not enter content unavailable to my account.
As a learner, I want to watch course videos and resume at the supported playback position, so that I can continue an interrupted lesson.
As a learner, I want to have learning progress recorded under the correct course, chapter and task, so that my results are not mixed across contexts.
As a learner, I want to complete chapter exercises and use permitted reset and retry actions, so that I can practice according to the course rules.
As a learner, I want to use course practical resources, self-tests, checkpoints and flag submissions, so that I can demonstrate the required skills.
As a learner, I want to access permitted course attachments, comments, recommendations and favorites, so that I can use the supporting learning resources.
As a learner, I want to find and claim tasks when claiming is permitted, so that I can begin assigned or available learning work.
As a learner, I want to open teaching-task details and the associated course and topic views, so that I can follow the required curriculum.
As a learner, I want to inspect teaching-task progress and results, so that I can understand my completion status.
As a learner, I want to browse virtual subjects and enter permitted subject activities, so that I can perform the relevant practical training.
As a learner, I want to inspect a learning route and its stages, courses, subjects and equipment activities, so that I understand the intended learning sequence.
As a learner, I want to have route-specific learning results attributed to the correct route task, so that my progress reflects the work I actually completed.
